title: Sindh Institute of Ophthalmology and Visual Sciences Amendment Act 2019

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Institute of Ophthalmology and Visual Sciences Amendment Act 2019
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XIV OF 2019
ACT XIV OF 2019
SINDH INSTITUTE OF OPHTHALMOLOGY AND
VISUAL SCIENCES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2019
An Act to amend the Sindh Institute of
Ophthalmology
and Visual Sciences Act, 2013
[Gazette of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV,
4th December, 2019]
NO.
PAS/LEGIS-B-16/2019, dated 4.12.2019.---The Sindh Institute of Ophthalmology and Visual Sciences (Amendment)
Bill, 2019 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 13th
November, 2019 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 27th November, 2019
is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the Sindh
Institute of Ophthalmology and Visual Sciences Act, 2013, in the manner
hereinafter appearing;
It is
hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Sindh Institute of Ophthalmology and Visual Sciences
(Amendment) Act, 2019.
(2) It shall
come into force at once.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Institute of Ophthalmology and Visual Sciences Amendment Act 2019
sections.description:
Amendment of section 5 of Sindh Act No.XXVI of 2013

ACT XIV OF 2019
ACT XIV OF 2019
SINDH INSTITUTE OF OPHTHALMOLOGY AND
VISUAL SCIENCES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2019
An Act to amend the Sindh Institute of
Ophthalmology
and Visual Sciences Act, 2013
[Gazette of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV,
4th December, 2019]
NO.
PAS/LEGIS-B-16/2019, dated 4.12.2019.---The Sindh Institute of Ophthalmology and Visual Sciences (Amendment)
Bill, 2019 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 13th
November, 2019 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 27th November, 2019
is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the Sindh
Institute of Ophthalmology and Visual Sciences Act, 2013, in the manner
hereinafter appearing;
It is
hereby enacted as follows:-
4. Amendment
of section 5 of Sindh Act No.XXVI of 2013.---In the said Act, in section 5 -
(a) for
clause (iv), the following shall be substituted:-
"(iv)
to undertake postgraduate teaching and training programme such as M.S., MCPS,
FCPS, Ophthalmology and Visual Sciences, diploma in Ophthalmology, B.S. (Visual
Sciences) and Ph.D. in Ophthalmology in collaboration with College of
Physicians and Surgeons of Pakistan and affiliated Medical or Health Sciences
University recognized under Higher Education Commission and in accordance with
Pakistan and Medical Dental Council criteria";
(b) after
clause (iv), the following new clauses shall be inserted:-
"(iv-a)
to undertake undergraduate teaching and training programme in the subject of
ophthalmology;
(iv-b)
to hold examinations and to award and confer degree, in Ophthalmology and
Visual Sciences diploma certificate and other academic distinctions to and on
the persons who have been admitted to and have passed its examinations under
prescribed conditions;
(iv-c)
to establish the satellite ophthalmology centers of the Institute at other
districts of the Province of Sindh and to operate a regional centre of
excellence and tertiary level facility in any taluka or district and to
administer the eye units or hospitals in the Province of Sindh as may be
considered necessary or expedient by Government;
(iv-d)
to coordinate and collaborate with Provincial, National and International
organizations in the field of ophthalmology with the approval of the
Board;".
(iv-e)
Eye Hospital Khairpur be handed over to the Sindh Institute of Ophthalmology
and Visual Sciences.
